reason: Owner requested a GitHub repo dtadpole/lastwar recording knowledge, activities and all play records, following reflection shared typed-folder conventions and constitutions.
Owner requested web research to start filling the knowledge in the repo. Claims cross-checked across named sources, with disagreements and single-source items marked.

Owner asked for one full round of the daily checklist on the Mac mini session. All claims, dispatches, donations and state changes are itemised in the play record, including the disclosure of a likely accidental Gold Mine upgrade.

Owner asked whether activity types were individual folders accumulating knowledge per type, and whether executions were recorded per task for later lookup. They were not - activities were one daily-activities checklist and executions were only the per day narrative. Split 14 activity folders, added per activity execution records backfilled for 2026-10-25, and updated the recording rules to match.

Owner directed records be organised by date, then folder structure by activity type within each date, with one execution written as a record at a time under each activity folder. Moved the 2026-10-25 day record and its 14 activity entries from play-sessions and activity-executions into _records_/2026-10-25/<activity>/1100-daily-round.md with facts unchanged, and updated all live references.

Owner set the standing workflow for future task requests - check whether the task type metadata exists, create and note it if missing and then execute and log records, keep task type metadata in its own top level folder never nested in records, and for existing types only check and update metadata and skip execution until a future cycle. Verified the current layout already conforms - _activities_ is a top level sibling of _records_ and records subfolders carry no type knowledge.

Owner named three tasks - a train task, a plunder and truck task, and alliance tech - and set two metadata rules in the same minutes, that task metadata record how to enter the task and remember its cadence and its scope and availability. Checked first under the intake workflow - troop training, Intercity Trade trucks and the alliance train had no metadata, so their folders were created and registered with entry, cadence and scope sections before execution. Alliance tech matched the existing alliance-donations type, so the alias was recorded and its metadata gained the new standard sections. The intake workflow now requires the entry, cadence and scope sections for every task type.

Executed the three new types in game on the owner Mac mini and checked the existing one, session 12:20 to about 13:02 local. Queued all four barracks at their highest tiers for 14.5M food and 14.5M iron in total. Boarded carriage 1 of the AP3x alliance train with the free Like and Thank, no contract gifted. Won one Quick Plunder against a 7.6M guard for iron 273.4K, food 273.4K, coin 173.9K and two chest stacks, then dispatched all four own trucks - one SSR after the single free refresh of the day, three UR as rolled - spending no Trade Contract or diamond. Alliance Techs were checked only, Rallied Attack 7 of 10 and Tech Donation Today 300 points, with no donation made, per the workflow for existing types.

Owner directed that the three types intaken earlier the same day - troop training, truck plunder and the alliance train - be folded into the daily round. The daily umbrella now lists them as part of the round with their per round jobs, and the task list records the decision.

Owner numbered tasks 4, 5, 6 and 8. Passes already belong to shop-claims - its metadata gained measured entry, cadence and scope plus the afternoon claim facts (Drone Parts daily pickup claimed, Free Supply auto claimed). VIP rewards and Alliance Duel (owner wording - weekly alliance dual ceremony) had no type and were registered as vip-rewards and alliance-duel before execution, per the intake workflow. Arms Race became its own type arms-race with a standing four hourly check - cron lastwar-arms-race-4h-check created, first run 2026-10-25 about 17.47 PDT. In game execution of the pass remainder, VIP and the duel was blocked twice - first the iPhone held the session (owner then closed the phone app), then the Mac was found locked; execution is queued for when the Mac is unlocked.

After the owner closed the phone app and unlocked the Mac, the queued in game work ran. Coin Weekly Pass pickup claimed and Monthly Pass verified; VIP 13 Daily Freebie claimed and the VIP entry, cadence and privileges measured, which also resolved the truck Mega Mode question (a VIP 13 privilege). Alliance Duel checked - League S38 starting soon, roulette at 0 tokens, nothing claimable. The live Arms Race phase showed 75,047 points from the midday training queues and all three point chests were claimed. Metadata for the three new types was updated to measured values, and the shop metadata gained the warning that the Legendary Claim All label is a 19.99 dollar purchase button.

The owner recheck caught the one real miss of the day - task 6 (weekly alliance dual ceremony) names the Alliance Star Ceremony behind the base trophy icon, not the VS duel screens checked at 1359. The ceremony (Event 38) was played end to end under the owner procedure - keep forwarding, act on actionable icons including emotes, at least 3 loves requested and 6 sent - and all rewards were claimed (emote tiers, 14 star member rewards, Participation Prize ruby 500). The alliance-duel metadata was rewritten to version 1.2.0 with the ceremony entry, procedure and reward structure, at the owner direction to note the process in the task metadata so it is not missed again. The owner then directed a red dot sweep of the base and reminded that the alliance help icon is to be clicked wherever it appears; both follow in the next entries.

The owner red dot sweep ran end to end. Alliance Help All pressed (help points 400 of 1000 shown, own requests already full). Task 9 named and executed - a new survivor-intake type was registered with entry, cadence and scope, and the front gate line was cleared (six recruits by card plus dialog survivors; a notification prompt was cancelled, not enabled). Season passes claimed - Battle Pass plus 500 points to 16,800 and the Weekly Pass freebie and daily pickup. Radar - two Quick Execute batches and 11 rewards claimed, stored tasks to 0 of 40. Production bubbles collected; the Status Overview season numbers (output plus 12.5 percent, Thermal Weapon plus 150, Virus Resistance 10,500) were added to the season knowledge file. Events held nothing claimable - the badge was the Frontline challenge attempt marker, not played. Nothing bought, nothing spent, Quick Dispatch never pressed.

Standing four hourly Arms Race check under the owner standing instruction of 2026-10-25 (task 8, check Arms Race every four hours). Device access for this exact schedule returned a non-retryable result - the schedule lacks owner-authorized device access - so the Mac mini was never opened and the game was never entered. Phase, points, rank and chests are recorded as unread, no task completed, no chest claimed, nothing spent. No new user input line is added, as this is a standing instruction run. Prior Arms Race record today was performed, so this is not a third consecutive access failure and no chat escalation is made.
